Senior Manual QA Engineer - Warsaw (On-site)

Digis (a Fiverr company) 🔥 Responds Quickly
$$$$

About Digis
 

Digis is a European IT company with 250+ specialists delivering complex products for 70+ clients across the U.S., Europe, and Canada. We focus on long-term collaboration, stable projects, and transparent processes.
 

About the Project
 

You will join an AI-powered media/e-commerce product focused on creating digital media and video content around products and specific niches.

The product enables users to create content using AI-generated avatars and influencers that can produce media on the user's behalf. The project is currently actively scaling.

The QA Engineer will play a key role in owning product quality, improving QA processes, and introducing AI-assisted testing practices where they bring real value.
 

Requirements
 

  • 5+ years of professional QA experience, with a strong focus on manual testing
  • Strong experience with web application testing and product quality ownership
  • Hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools in QA workflows

  • Upper-Intermediate or higher English level, with confidence participating in frequent and extended meetings in English

     

Responsibilities
 

  • Design and execute manual tests for a modern web application
  • Investigate, reproduce, and clearly document bugs
  • Take ownership of QA processes and overall product quality
  • Establish and continuously improve testing processes as the product scales
  • Use AI and off-the-shelf tools to improve testing efficiency, monitoring, defect analysis, and QA workflows
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineering leadership to continuously improve product quality
     

Advantages
 

  • Take real ownership of product quality rather than simply executing predefined test cases
  • Shape and improve QA processes while the engineering team is actively scaling
  • Work with AI-generated content, avatars, and modern AI/LLM technologies
  • Apply AI tools not only within the product domain but also to accelerate and improve QA workflows
  • Work in a modern engineering environment with Python, React, AWS, APIs, automation, and cloud integrations
  • Collaborate directly with engineering leadership and startup decision-makers
  • Join a long-term project at a stage where your QA approach and technical decisions can have a meaningful impact on the product
     

We Offer
 

  • 20 paid vacation days per year
  • 5 paid sick days
  • Compensation for professional courses
  • English learning support
  • Work equipment
  • Transparent communication and processes
  • Accounting support
  • Corporate psychologist

Required languages

English B2 - Upper Intermediate
